metas.name: Furious
metas.description: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: CIA
metas.description: Follows a partnership between a C.I.A Case Officer and an F.B.I. Special Agent who work together on a clandestine task force to prevent domestic terrorism in New York. Available on Paramount+ in 1080p.
